title: FileDownload
description: One piece of the files read_deliverable sends to the employee's working directory. Chunks are sent before the tool.result that references their download_id; the daemon keeps them for that call only, checks sizes and checksums, and writes the files under .agent-deliverables/.

index.description: 0-based position of this chunk in the download (all files concatenated in tool.result download.files order).
